research_summary: The Netherlands project management software market shows strong cloud adoption (75% market share), emphasis on GDPR compliance, and preference for customizable solutions. Market size projected at USD 9.76 billion in 2025, growing at 15.65% CAGR to USD 20.20 billion by 2030.
market_observations: 75% cloud adoption. Unit4 is key Dutch local player specializing in public sector and professional services. SaaS growing 18.59% (2024-2029). Dutch businesses prioritize GDPR compliance, EU data residency, customization.
